## Context
Implement the admin dashboard for managing policies, devices, live sessions, and the mid-session kill button.

## Requirements
- Policy management UI: authoring, versioning, publishing, what-if testing
- Device enrollment and revocation UI
- Live sessions view with real-time status
- Kill button for mid-session termination
- Admin overview with health and latency metrics

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Admins can author, version, publish, and test policies
- [ ] Device enrollment/revocation functional
- [ ] Live sessions display with kill button works
- [ ] Kill button triggers mid-session termination
- [ ] Admin overview displays service health
